question.text: What does CAN stand for in the MFU system?

explanation.text: The Logic: CAN stands for Common Account Number. It is a single account number created under MF Utilities (MFU) that allows an investor to transact across all participating AMCs without needing separate folios everywhere. The Trap: CAN is not about assets, authorization, or notices. It is specifically a common account number for unified mutual fund transactions. Cross-Exam Context: Also tested in Series V-A. CAN is the key feature that makes MFU useful — one number for all AMCs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Help your clients create a CAN if they invest across multiple AMCs. It simplifies their record-keeping and makes transactions more convenient.
